points.text: Browser Back from any page returns to the page before it (one step, never two).

After an edge swipe back, the browser Back button still goes further back (not forward).

Backspace (outside a text field) goes back one page.
Backspace inside a text field deletes a character and never leaves the page.
Alt+← goes back; Alt+→ goes forward.
Back with a popup open closes the popup first and stays on the page.

…→ forward returns to the product.

Slider: mouse over → still; mouse leaves → moving again ≤ 0.5 s
Slider: sideways wheel / trackpad on the row, then leave → moving ≤ 0.5 s
Slider: mouse drag released on the row → still while the mouse is over it; leave → moving ≤ 0.5 s
Slider: mouse drag released off the row → moving ≤ 0.85 s (glide + 0.5 s)
Slider: mouse leaves while the row is still gliding to a card edge → moving ≤ 0.5 s after the glide (no 4 s hold for a mouse)
Slider: page wheel-scrolled past a row → the row moves ≤ 0.5 s once it is no longer under the cursor
Slider: a mouse drag moves every row (category, product, account too) — no browser "ghost" link drag
Slider: 20 fast enter/leave cycles → ends outside: moving; ends inside: still
Slider: page redraw (heart, quick add, language) under a resting mouse → row stays still

Hero arrows fade in on hover and out on leave — also after they were clicked
Hero: keyboard focus on a slide → still; focus leaves → moving after the 1.5 s grace
Phone: tap → 4 s hold (3.8–4.6 s) then drift; swipe → glide to card, hold, drift (3.9–5.0 s); a tap never leaves the hover flag on
